0.2.2-rc.3.changelog:
> 上游版本 `dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3`　|　本仓库发布版本 `0.2.2-rc.3` [中文](#cn-v0.2.2-rc.3) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-rc.3)

新增功能

- 新增实验性「DeepSeek 会话导入」插件，支持将 DeepSeek App 或网页版的历史会话导入工作区，并继续对话。 @imccyu ### 问题修复 - 修复 Windows 桌面版应用内更新可能失败、无法自动重新打开的问题。 @winewill

New Features

- Add an experimental DeepSeek chat import plugin to import past conversations from DeepSeek App or its web version into a workspace and continue chatting. by @imccyu ### Bug Fixes - Fix an issue that could cause Windows desktop in-app updates to fail and prevent the app from reopening automatically. by @winewill Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3 --- 飞牛打包层改动（与上游版本无关）见 [Release 说明](https://github.com/yoqie/FFFFFFFFNNNN/releases/tag/dsh-0.2.2-rc.3)。
